_about: Hand-made content of the shared coverage matrix that build_coverage_matrix.py cannot derive from the DB or the corpus. The builder merges it on every run, so a rebuild never drops it. Edit HERE, not in the xlsx, or the next rebuild discards the edit.

conferences._source: Track C of the 2026-09-17 download push; outputs/download_push_2026-09-17/INTEGRATION/coverage_matrix_applied.md. n_needed is the queue-row count frozen on that date (conference_lead_candidates does not know these series).

rows.series: SVP (Society of Vertebrate Paleontology annual meeting)
rows.organisers: Society of Vertebrate Paleontology. Annual meeting; abstracts published as a "Supplement to Number 3" (pre-2013 volumes) or "(Suppl. N)" issue of the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology, one abstract per page, page numbers suffixed "A" (e.g. 29(Suppl. to No.3), 52A). Elasmobranch-relevant abstracts run at least 1988-2020 in this corpus; the series itself runs continuously to the present.

rows.series: SICB (Society for Integrative and Comparative Biology)
rows.organisers: Society for Integrative and Comparative Biology (formed 1991 from the American Society of Zoologists). Annual meeting abstracts published as a January Suppl. 1 issue of Integrative and Comparative Biology (formerly American Zoologist for the ASZ-era predecessor, 1961-1996), one abstract per page, pages prefixed "E" (e.g. 54(IS Suppl. 1): E48). 3 more elasmobranch abstracts found under the predecessor title American Zoologist (1978, 1980, 1985), same page-suffix convention but ending "A" not "E".

Società Italiana di Biologia Marina. Annual congress; short (1-2 page) proceedings notes published in the society journal Biologia Marina Mediterranea (ISSN 1123-4245) alongside the journal's normal full-length articles -- so NOT every Biologia Marina Mediterranea record is a congress note, only the short ones (page span <=2). Elasmobranch-relevant notes seen 1999-2015 in this corpus.
